A warm, calm photograph of a cozy, well-made workplace: Our laptop stands open on a honey-oak desk in warm late sun, with a clear glass of water beside it and the leafy shadow of a plant across the wood.

References: Image 1 is the laptop: take its exact shape, thin bezels and dark body; no logo on the lid. Image 2 is the keyboard layout: take plain blank keycaps with even gaps, no letters. The output is one single photograph, landscape 16:9.

Shot: Camera in front of the desk, a little above the keyboard, 50mm lens, f/5.6, square to the screen. The screen fills about 50 percent of the frame width on the centre line, sharp; the glass of water at one side throws a bright caustic and long shadow on the oak; the pale grey chair back at the far edge; leafy shadows across the desk, never over the screen. Nobody is in frame.

Place: A quiet studio workspace: solid honey-oak desks, white walls, a pale grey office chair, a plant somewhere out of frame; nothing else unless the shot names it.

Light: Warm low late-afternoon sun through a window: long crisp shadows, the soft leafy shadow pattern of a plant across the desk, and bright caustics thrown by clear glass.

Palette and grade: Warm honey oak, soft white, pale grey, dark aluminium; deep but soft shadows; the screen or design surface clean neutral white. The same grade on every image of the collection.

Real: this is a product mockup photograph, so the design surface is the hero: large, sharp and fully readable; shadows and caustics fall beside it, never over it. It is a real photograph, never a render. The design surface faces the camera almost square-on, within about 15 degrees, so it reads flat and undistorted; its four edges run parallel to the edges of the photograph, a true rectangle, never a trapezoid or keystone; flat things on a table are shot from nearly straight above. Only the objects named in the shot are on set. Every object is at its true real-world size.

Design surface: THE SCREEN SHOWS A PLAIN WHITE FULL-SCREEN IMAGE, evenly lit edge to edge, crisp corners inside its thin black bezel, nothing on it.

Finish: Shot like a calm editorial interior on a full-frame camera: natural warm colour, soft fine grain, crisp sun shadows; quiet and premium, never a render.

Avoid: a face, chin, lips or profile, logos, letters or brand names anywhere, any image, icon or text on the screen or surface, any object not named in the shot, a clean smooth 3D render look.
